The four tables list every atom of one conventional cubic cell of four crystals (files named by crystal). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights and first-order Bragg diffraction; the relevant peak is the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity. Weights: diamond: C = 6; Ga N: Ga = 31, N = 7; MOF-5: C = 6, H = 1, O = 8, Zn = 30; aluminium nickel: Al = 13, Ni = 28. For X-rays of wavelength 0.70930 Å, you must choose the crystal whose lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity lies closest to 2θ = 19.90° (for example, to calibrate a detector at that angle). Which crystal should you choose?

选项：
A. aluminium nickel (COD9008802-cell.txt)
B. Ga N (COD1536825-cell.txt)
C. MOF-5 (COD1516287-cell.txt)
D. diamond (COD9008564-cell.txt)

附件：COD9008564-cell.txt、COD1536825-cell.txt、COD1516287-cell.txt、COD9008802-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
